cases.title: The starter about AI agents
cases.question: How does Brad ship with AI agents?
cases.answer: Brad ships with AI agents through a system built around checks and human approval. The system around them is: docs every agent reads before it starts, one isolated checkout per agent, tests the coding agent can't rewrite, a second agent that reviews its work, a gate and a kill switch on every new feature, and one audited door to production, with evals and alerts feeding back into what gets built next. Releases are a separate, pinned step. Merging to master deploys nothing. A release happens only when Brad asks for one. Most new features reach production turned off, so merging and deploying code doesn't change what customers see.
